about: an archive extracted without checking its paths
diff: +    # archive_path is an archive uploaded by the user

answer.title: CWE-22: archive entries can be written outside the destination
answer.description: A user-uploaded tar file can contain entries such as ../../etc/cron.d/job. extractall() writes them outside destination, so an attacker can overwrite any file the service can write.
answer.suggestion: Extract with the data filter, which rejects absolute paths and '..': archive.extractall(destination, filter="data").
